summary: Phase 13 (Dispute Chat backend + PWA + Hero redesign + Mobile drawer) end-to-end validated. Backend: 12/12 new pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_phase13_dispute_chat_pwa.py — covers GET/POST /api/disputes/{id}/messages (404/403/200, empty=400, closed=400, sorted asc), cross-role notifications (buyer->seller, seller->buyer, admin->both), and PWA /manifest.json + /service-worker.js. Frontend: buyer /disputes chat panel opens via dispute-toggle-chat-<id>, sends messages, message appears in list; admin /admin/disputes thread toggle works, admin post is labeled 'Support'. Hero carousel renders with 'Good morning' greeting ribbon, hero-shop-now CTA, trust chips (4 visible: Buyer protection / Fast delivery / Verified sellers / Loved by millions). Mobile drawer (390x844) opens from hamburger, contains 6 drawer-link-* items, backdrop + close button work. Manifest returns theme_color=#FF211F, display=standalone. Service-worker contains install & fetch listeners.

minor.issue: 6 pre-existing regression tests fail with KeyError: 'dispute_id' in module-level order_ctx fixture (dependency-ordering bug in the earlier test file, NOT a server regression). The Phase 12 server endpoints themselves still work (verified via Phase 13 admin resolve flow which passes).
One pre-existing Phase 11 test error at setup (independent of Phase 13 changes).

ui_bugs.issue: Trust chips do not carry a data-testid (spec asked for hero-trust-chip*). Chips render correctly but cannot be selected by testid — used visual + text verification instead.

drawer-link-home has empty suffix testid ('drawer-link-'). Also, clicking drawer-link- (Home) while already on / does not visibly close the drawer (React Router same-URL nav; onClose not fired). Non-Home links close drawer correctly.
Email/password inputs still lack data-testid. Testing agent had to inject JWT via localStorage to bypass. Repeated feedback across iterations.

action_items: Add data-testid to Login form inputs & submit button (persisted debt).
Add data-testid='hero-trust-chip-<i>' to hero trust chips so future tests can target them directly.
Fix drawer-link- (empty suffix) for Home link; also close drawer on same-URL clicks.
Fix the ordering / shared fixture bug in test_phase12_disputes_featured.py (order_ctx['dispute_id'] missing) — cosmetic regression file bug only, not a server bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_dispute_messages caps at .to_list(500) with no pagination — long dispute threads will silently truncate. Add limit/skip params.
post_dispute_message accepts up to 8 photos but never validates that each URL points to /api/files/<id> owned by the sender — a caller could inject arbitrary URLs (XSS-in-image / phishing).

notify() failure inside the loop only logs .warning; but the whole POST still returns 200. Consider making at least one of buyer/seller notify failure raise a 500 (or a debug field) so we detect a regression like the Phase 12 Literal issue earlier.

Frontend polls every 6s while the dispute is open (per spec). No visibility gating (document.hidden) — a laptop with 50 open disputes will hammer the API. Recommend a shared abort/poll manager or pausing when tab hidden.

Home.jsx HERO_HIGHLIGHTS hero-shop-now selector points to a Link to /search — but only the first slide's CTA has data-testid=hero-shop-now (there are 3 slides in the carousel and only the active slide's CTA is rendered — OK, but confirm auto-rotate pauses on hover as spec requires; visual verify not asserted).
MobileDrawer close-on-navigate relies on link's onClick — will not fire when route matches current URL (Home from Home) — as observed in test.
/api/files/ still embeds ?auth= in ; unchanged since iteration 7 feedback.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (hero, mobile drawer, buyer chat, admin thread, PWA all verified)

seed_data_creation: Added 3 TEST_p13_* sophia listings and their orders + disputes (one closed by admin reject during test_closed_dispute_rejects_post). Non-disruptive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 13 endpoints + UI are fully working. To exercise the dispute chat E2E without the login form, POST /api/auth/register to get a token then localStorage.setItem('mercari_token', token) before navigating. Category creation requires category_id (not category). The 6 Phase 12 regression failures are a test-file fixture bug (module-level order_ctx dict never gets 'dispute_id' populated when tests run in a different order under xdist loadscope); server behaviour verified indirectly via Phase 13 admin resolve path.
rca of the issue: N/A — no P0/P1 issues discovered in Phase 13. Pre-existing Phase 12 test-file failures are caused by state-shared module-level fixture (`order_ctx`) that only gets populated by TestDisputeCreate but is read by TestDisputeDetail / TestAdminResolve; when xdist loadscope groups classes across workers, the reader class runs before the writer and sees the empty dict. Solution: promote order_ctx to a session-scoped pytest fixture with explicit dependencies, or run those classes on the same worker.
